shape.situation_pattern: Congestion vs calm: a mill that overcharges (spends marks on locked lanes) leaves the operator afraid to use it.
shape.decision: Prefer the lane that was actually open (the door that answered reliably) even if it isn't the cheapest nominal rate.
shape.reasoning_physics: Dollar cache-hit is not the metric; calm-to-file is. If the operator fears touching the mill, it already overcharged in calm.
